# Turn any marketplace or payment export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free sales export to journal converter for Airbnb, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Gumroad, DistroKid, YouTube AdSense, Amazon KDP, PayPal, Shopify, Square and Stripe: drop the CSV, the page detects the platform, proves the rows add up to the payout, and downloads month-split journals for Xero or QuickBooks.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
